### 2026-10-30: I finished the schematic and assigned the footprints, I had no idea what to use so i went to past projects like starbie and midi to check which footprints I coul use, I also went to google and searche

**2.7h**

I finished the schematic and assigned the footprints, I had no idea what to use so i went to past projects like starbie and midi to check which footprints I coul use, I also went to google and searched which footprints I wanted to use, then I created the PCB, edge cuts and connected almost everything while making ti so the IRs would be on the front and that the buttons were in a "humane" spot and that they were easily pressed by two people, because of the 1v1 games.
I will finish the rest of the connections in the next entry.
